messages:
noah: Found a tiny crown made of paperclips on the office couch this morning with a sticky note: "Long live the Paperclip King." Anyone claim royal duty?

mina: Not me but I approve. Whoever made it has my vote for Most Likely To Fix A Jam With Duct Tape. :crown:

tasha: Guilty. I crafted it during standup after someone mentioned clip management. Its ceremonial, not political.

remo: Can we have an investiture? I will provide a playlist and dramatic lighting (desk lamps count).

leo: Proposal: create a small ceremony at 16:00, bring coffee, read a 3-line proclamation. Reactions: + for yes, - for no.

ops-bot: Reminder - please keep common seating clear for facilities checks. If you put items on couches, label them with owner and date. :pushpin:

mina: Also suggestion: title alternatives - Paperclip King, Clip Czar, Keeper of Loose Ends. Vote with emoji.

tasha: I vote Keeper of Loose Ends. It has gravitas.

remo: I will make a tiny scroll (Post-it) with the proclamation. Draft: "By the power vested in office supplies, we hereby crown the Keeper of Loose Ends to guard stray cables and single socks." Thoughts?

leo: Add clause: the Keeper must perform one noble act per week (e.g., reattach a badge, return a stray charger).

facilities-bot: FYI: items left on couches overnight may be moved to lost-and-found after 48 hours. Please label personal items. :file_folder:

noah: Love the weekly noble act. Can we have an enamel pin? I will chip in for production if there's interest.

mina: If we get pins, may I design a tiny paperclip cape. Tiny capes for tiny royals.

tasha: Ceremony confirmed 16:00 in lounge. Bring a prop and a brief oath (3 lines max). I will supply the crown and glitter-free confetti. :sparkles:

remo: RSVP: @remo +1 (playlist ready). @noah we will collect funds for pins after the coronation.

leo: Great. Putting a calendar invite. This thread closed but coronation open to all. Long live the Keeper of Loose Ends! :paperclip:
